title: Natonal Air Force Museum of Canada

services.name: Venue Rentals
services.desc: In the NAFMC Restoration Workshop a highly skilled team of volunteers dedicate their time and expertise to re-construct, restore, and repair historic Canadian military aircraft for static display - helping to preserve your air force history for generations to come. The RCAF Memorial Airpark is dedicated to preserving the legacy of Canada’s air force personnel. Get up close to over 30 aircraft that have served Canada at home and abroad, and explore the monuments and memorials dedicated to current members and veterans. The NAFMC is a self-funded institution that relies on the support of our generous community to support operations. Learn how you can directly donate to the Museum and help
